India's Rice Exports Attract Global Buyers for 2026 Event

India has attracted significant global interest for its rice exports, with 3,317 buyers from 138 countries registering for the upcoming BIRC 2026 event. The Indian Rice Exporters Federation (IREF) organized the registration, indicating a strong international demand for Indian rice.
